name: Elemental Spirits
description: The four classes of nature spirits — gnomes (earth), undines (water), sylphs (air), and salamanders (fire) — codified in the 16th-century writings of Paracelsus and elaborated through Rosicrucian, Theosophical, and modern occult traditions.

aliases.name: Sagani
aliases.meaning: Paracelsus's collective term for the four elementals (De Meteoris)

origin: Conceptually global — wherever earth, water, air, or fire is found — but the systematic classification originates in Western European Renaissance occultism and has spread globally through Rosicrucian, Theosophical, and modern esoteric currents.
